steps: Combine Rice, Coconut milk, Water, and Turmeric in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat, cover, and cook for 18 minutes until rice is tender.
Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place Salmon skin-side down on the sheet; drizzle with Olive oil and Lemon juice.
Bake Salmon for 12 to 15 minutes, until flesh flakes easily and no pink remains at the centre.
Meanwhile, mince Garlic and sauté in a small pan with a little Olive oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add thinly sliced Carrot (cooked) and Spinach; stir over medium heat for 3 minutes until wilted.
Flake cooked Salmon into large chunks, discarding the skin and any bones.
Divide coconut rice into bowls; top with vegetables, Salmon, and Fresh dill.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
